_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/modes/test_modal_variable_size_targets.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_abzan_will` is Will of the Abzan: a caster-sized player target ('any number of target opponents') owned by the FIRST mode, with the second mode owning a fixed graveyard target -- the shape a positional split could not store.

cards.name: Test Abzan Will
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead.
• Any number of target opponents each sacrifice a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls and lose 3 life.
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

modes.label: Any number of target opponents each sacrifice a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls and lose 3 life.
Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
